page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.6xlarge belongs to the high clock speed compute instance family, built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 CPU architecture. It features a 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 8369HB processor delivering 24 dedicated vCPUs across 12 physical cores via two threads per core. Memory allocation is configured at 96 GB, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4 GB per virtual core. Cache infrastructure incorporates 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 33 MB of shared L3 cache. Supported CPU extensions include AVX, AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16, AES, and bit manipulation instructions, though AMX and SHA extensions are absent.

Standardized benchmark testing places the server within expected mid-tier ranges across general CPU metrics, recording a stress-ng multi-core score of 24950.58 and a PassMark CPU score of 25408.19. Memory subsystems show higher relative throughput, with PassMark memory achieving a top-quartile score of 2847.06. Memory transfer rates demonstrate 90.69 GB/sec during large-block uncached read operations and 53.33 GB/sec on sequential writes. Parallel data processing capability is demonstrated by a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 114.72 GB/sec, while CPU-based inference executes small language models at 79.41 generation tokens per second.

Architecturally, the server contains no attached local storage, relying entirely on network-attached block storage devices to manage file systems and stateful data. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 8 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and the configuration contains zero GPU accelerators. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high clock speed Intel processor combined with dedicated core scheduling provides predictable execution times without the premium cost associated with hardware accelerators or local NVMe arrays. The platform is well suited for software build pipelines, batch data processing, Redis caching deployments, enterprise web serving, and database applications running against remote storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.6xlarge is a high clock speed compute-optimized virtual server powered by a 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. Operating on KVM virtualization with an x86_64 architecture, this instance supplies 24 dedicated vCPUs across 12 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, complemented by 96 GB of system memory. Vector acceleration instructions including AVX-512 with VNNI and bfloat16 are natively supported. Benchmark tests reflect solid multi-core processing alongside strong memory tier scores, registering uncached read bandwidth exceeding 90 GB/s and multi-threaded decompression at 114.72 GB/s. The instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions, and provides an 8 Gbps baseline network throughput. With a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation, it delivers dependable resource density and sustained CPU throughput without GPU overhead. These characteristics make the instance suitable for code compilation, static web serving clusters, Redis caches, data transformation jobs, and backend application servers.
